name: Three Nought Four
description: 304 is a trick-taking partnership game for four. 32-card deck. Card values: J=30, 9=20, A=11, 10=10, K=3, Q=2, 8=7=0. Total 304 points. Bid from 160 in tens; highest bidder sets trump face-down then remaining cards dealt. Follow suit; bidding team must make bid in points. Popular in Sri Lanka and India.

content.text: 304 is a trick-taking partnership game for four. 32-card deck. Card values: J=30, 9=20, A=11, 10=10, K=3, Q=2, 8=7=0. Total 304 points. Bid from 160 in tens; highest bidder sets trump face-down then remaining cards dealt. Follow suit; bidding team must make bid in points. Popular in Sri Lanka and India.
Sri Lanka and coastal India (Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra). Named after 304 total points.
Four players in two fixed partnerships; partners sit opposite (e.g. North-South vs East-West). Deal and play are counter-clockwise.
A standard 32-card pack: 7, 8, 9, 10, J, Q, K, A in all four suits (spades, clubs, diamonds, hearts). Total point value in the pack is 304.
Four cards at a time counter-clockwise; after bid, rest dealt; trump face-down.
